concepts.quote: default always runs at the end of a switch
concepts.why: The rule contradicts Java: default runs only when no case matches or when execution falls through into it; here result is 50 only because case 2 falls through case 3, case 4 and default with no breaks, so the right value rests on a wrong rule.
The answer says nothing about statements running in sequence.
A bare correct final value of result with no justification of which assignments ran is a bare result, L1.
